title: Clamp a Value
statement:
Write a function `clamp(x, lo, hi)` that keeps a number inside a range. It returns `lo` when `x` is below `lo`, `hi` when `x` is above `hi`, and `x` itself otherwise.

The input is one line with three integers `x`, `lo`, and `hi`, separated by spaces. Each value is between -1000000 and 1000000, and `lo` is always less than or equal to `hi`. Print the clamped value.

Input:

```text
15 0 10
```

Expected output:

```text
10
```
hints: There are only three possible answers: `lo`, `hi`, or `x`.
Check whether `x` is too small first, then whether it is too big. If neither is true, `x` is already in range.
